subject: Game Theory
title: The Replicator Equation
description: A quick win: understand The Replicator Equation.

hook.text: How do you model evolution mathematically? The replicator equation tracks strategy frequencies over time.

buildup.text: Strategies that earn above-average fitness grow. Those below average shrink. Simple but powerful.

discovery.text: The equation predicts which strategies survive, coexist, or go extinct in any given game.

twist.text: It can produce cycles: hawk replaces dove, dove replaces retaliator, retaliator replaces hawk—forever.

climax.text: The replicator equation connects evolutionary biology to dynamical systems in physics and math.

quiz.question: What does the replicator equation track?
